items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Anyway, Ray, Ray used to be around the store quite a bit, too.

ctx.x: Anyway, Ray, Ray used to be around the store quite a bit, too. And Ray, Ray used to tell me, he said, man, he used to, oh, he's going to write some drum company and tell him, you know, of course, we know all the drum companies, you know, the fellow that's in them. He said, I'm right so-and-so. He said, and George Ware, somebody else said, and Ray said, man, they come in here to buy a pair of drumsticks and you give them a free drum lesson, he used to say, you know, laugh. I said, well, I guess that's it, man. One…
Oh, you were talking about Tony Giardino? Now, who started with Tony? He did.
